courses.summary: 朗格勒海底天然氣管線是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為北海南北段的氣量與壓縮功協調；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: Langeled is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on gas inventory and compression-energy coordination between North Sea segments, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
